Mints ONE concept: the series/brand tag, on the exact precedent of #پرامپتولوژیست / #اینسایت / #نوت‌کست / #چیرساید — domain 'brand', definition «نام سری …», use_when «روی هر مدخل این سری، و هیچ‌جای دیگر.». It is minted ahead of part 1 because it is grounded in the section, not in any article: every part will carry it, exactly as every پرامپتولوژیست part carries its own. The urgency is measurable — `--simulate 'پلاک صفر'` currently returns #پلاک_پارسیل (a removable-partial clasp) as its top hit, so the series name resolves a reader to a denture article. Aliases cover the ZWNJ form, the ezafe form and both Latin transliterations, since the matcher compares tokens literally. NOTHING ELSE IS MINTED HERE: the chapter-1 vocabulary (site ownership, domains, platform choice, local search, information architecture, schema) is deliberately absent, because every batch in this directory derives its definitions from what a specific published article genuinely resolves, and پلاک صفر part 1 does not exist yet. Minting it now would be inventing permanent vocabulary for unwritten text.
